sentences.en: In April, Doug Bock Clark and Jen Fifield reported on Trump's efforts to “take over” the midterm elections, detailing how the administration has discarded or diminished endeavors across the federal government to protect the voting process or block foreign interference.
sentences.structure: 主干：Doug Bock Clark and Jen Fifield reported on Trump's efforts（主谓宾）。修饰：① to “take over” the midterm elections 是不定式作后置定语，限定 efforts；② detailing ... 是现在分词短语作伴随状语，说明“报道了什么内容”；③ detailing 后接 how 引导的宾语从句，从句主干为 the administration has discarded or diminished endeavors，endeavors 后又用不定式 to protect ... or block ... 作后置定语。
sentences.analysis_zh: 英文新闻常把“谁报道了什么”放在主干，“具体报道内容”用分词状语层层挂接，从而一句话装进大量信息。翻译时不必保留这种“挂葫芦”结构，可拆成两个中文小句：先交代报道主题，再说“详细说明了……”。注意 detailing 的逻辑主语是前面的记者，而非特朗普。

sentences.en: Wary of federal overreach, state officials — including some Republicans — have fought back, and so far every DOJ lawsuit that's been decided by a federal judge has been dismissed.
sentences.structure: 主干：由 and 连接的两个并列分句。① state officials have fought back；② every DOJ lawsuit ... has been dismissed。修饰：句首 Wary of federal overreach 是形容词短语作原因状语（= Because they were wary of ...）；破折号中的 including some Republicans 是插入语，补充说明 state officials；that's been decided by a federal judge 是定语从句修饰 lawsuit。
sentences.analysis_zh: 句首形容词短语作状语是外刊常见的压缩手段，比从句更简洁有力。第二个分句的真正主语是 lawsuit 而非 DOJ，所以谓语用 has been dismissed；that 定语从句用现在完成时的被动，暗示“至今已作出裁决的案件”这一累积状态。中文宜译成“凡已由联邦法官裁决的诉讼，全部被驳回”。

sentences.en: Ahead of the midterms, current and former government officials and election security experts have expressed concerns that once-fringe actors who've espoused debunked conspiracy theories about elections are now in positions to control the narrative around the voting process.
sentences.structure: 主干：officials and experts have expressed concerns（主谓宾）。修饰：① Ahead of the midterms 为时间状语；② that 引导同位语从句，说明 concerns 的具体内容；③ 从句主干为 once-fringe actors are now in positions；④ who've espoused ... 是定语从句修饰 actors；⑤ to control the narrative ... 是不定式作后置定语修饰 positions（“能够……的职位”）。
sentences.analysis_zh: 难点在于主语很长（current and former government officials and election security experts 三个并列成分），以及同位语从句里又套定语从句。concerns that ... 不能译成“担忧那个”，而应译成“担忧：……”。positions to control 中的 to control 修饰 positions 而非目的状语，译作“处在能够左右……的位子上”最贴切。

background.title: 美国选举为什么“归各州管”
background.text_zh: 美国宪法把选举的“时间、地点和方式”交由各州立法机关规定，联邦层面只由国会设定联邦选举的日期并监督选举权不被剥夺。因此选民登记、选民名册、投票机认证、邮寄投票规则长期由州和县一级选举官员掌握。联邦机构（如司法部民权司、网络安全和基础设施安全局、选举协助委员会）主要承担执法、情报共享与技术支持的角色，而非直接运营选举。文章所说的“联邦控制选举”，触动的正是这一两百年来形成的分权惯例，也是多州官员以“联邦越权”为由反击的制度根源。

background.title: SAVE Act 与“公民身份证明”之争
background.text_zh: SAVE Act（Safeguard American Voter Eligibility Act，《保障美国选民资格法案》）由共和党议员提出，核心是要求登记投票者出示公民身份证明文件（如护照、出生证明），并要求各州把选民名册交给国土安全部核验，以剔除名册中的非公民。支持者称这是防止非公民投票的必要措施；反对者指出，已有研究显示非公民投票极为罕见，而美国约有一定比例的合格选民没有现成护照或出生证明，该法会实际剥夺数百万人的投票权，并且会以“名册核验”为名把州级选举数据集中到联邦手中。文章第14段提到的2026年版本《SAVE美国法案》即在此脉络下提出，虽在众议院过关，却在参议院受阻。

title_en: How the Sphinx is helping answer a riddle about extinct crocodiles
excerpt_en: New technology is helping to identify extinct fossil species.
body_en: My colleagues and I discovered a new species of extinct crocodile from a fossil found in the same rocks used to carve the Great Sphinx of Giza.

Today, there are only two species of the long-snouted gavial crocodile, both of which are endangered: Gavialis gangeticus and Tomistoma schlegelii. They are found only in freshwater environments on the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia.

However, the fossil record of gavials goes back 80 million years, to the time of the dinosaurs. It shows that they were once diverse, with more than 40 species known, and lived all over the globe. So how did a group of crocodiles that today cannot tolerate saltwater once live all over the world? Our discovery may help to solve this puzzle.

Although the distribution of the continents differed from today, most were already separated by oceans. My colleagues and I have been trying to understand how gavials achieved this cosmopolitan distribution, while also seeking to unlock what led to their current predicament.

Studying the anatomy of the skeletons of living and fossil gavials has given us a better understanding of the group’s evolution in recent years. CT scans have enabled us to look inside their skulls, giving us a window into their brains and sensory systems.
This has revealed new anatomical information that helps differentiate species, and has allowed us to infer aspects of the biology and ecology of some of the extinct species.

For example, in an extinct group of crocodile relatives known to have lived entirely in the ocean, other researchers found thickening of the outer wall of their inner ear to cope with the higher pressures seen at ocean depths. My colleagues and I have found similar evidence for a marine lifestyle in some fossil gavials. This ability to live in the ocean was lost in living species, which are restricted to rivers and lakes.

Several of the gavial fossils we have been studying from Africa and Europe were first reported in the late 19th and early 20th centuries and they were often described as species of Tomistoma, i.e. closely related to Tomistoma schlegelii, one of the two living species of gavials. Our previous work and that of others has shown that some of these extinct species are not closely related to Tomistoma, with new names given for some of them. However, many of these historically described species remain neglected. Led by my former PhD student, Paul Burke, now a researcher at the Swedish Museum of Natural History in Stockholm, along with colleagues from Egypt and Germany, we re-examined one of these species in a new study.

In the 1920s, several fossils were collected from northeastern Egypt. These were found in a limestone rock, known as the Mokattam Formation, that had formed 45 million years ago in a shallow marine environment when sea levels were higher. This region was submerged at this time. These fossils, including a nearly complete skull, were described in 1927 as belonging to Tomistoma, because of their superficial resemblance to the living species, Tomistoma schlegelii.
However, aided by the use of CT scanning, our team was able to identify several anatomical differences, including the presence of raised rims around the eye sockets, which are absent in Tomistoma.

The Great Sphinx of Giza. Fernanda-Belen/Shutterstock The Mokattam Formation already has a legacy: 4,500 years ago, these rocks were used to carve the Great Sphinx of Giza. The gavial skull shares more than this origin story though. Just as the Sphinx is famously missing the tip of its nose, the fossil is also missing the tip of its snout. This coincidence led us to name the new crocodile Herugavialis cairensis after the Egyptian falcon-headed god Heru (also known as Horus), who is often thought to be the inspiration for the iconic Sphinx.

Both northern Africa and southern Europe hosted a high diversity of gavials (and other crocodiles) during much of the last 80 million years, with these species thriving in the shallow, marine environments that covered much of the Mediterranean region at the time.

Unlike living gavials, it is likely that some of these species could cross oceans. This diversity appears to have persisted through the devastating mass extinction that wiped out the dinosaurs, and probably fluctuated during alternating warmer and cooler intervals over the next 60 million years, tied to higher and lower sea levels, respectively.

However, crocodiles disappeared from the Mediterranean region approximately 6 million years ago and never returned. Their demise coincides with an event known as the Messinian salinity crisis, when the Mediterranean essentially dried up as a result of being sealed off from the Atlantic Ocean. As the seawater became increasingly salty with the heightened evaporation of water, it would have become ever more intolerable to the animals inhabiting it, even those usually able to live in saltwater, leading to the loss of crocodiles and many other species.

The signature of this event can still be observed today, with the Mediterranean Sea still much saltier than the oceans, and crocodiles entirely absent from this region. The remaining living gavials live far away from the Mediterranean, but the loss of the adaptations that would allow them to live in saltwater means that they would not be able to survive there regardless.

Rapid and extreme changes in temperature, sea level, and aridification are critical components of the current climate emergency, and events such as the Messinian salinity crisis show that they can have a lasting impact on biodiversity, spanning millions of years.

enrich.title_zh: 狮身人面像如何帮助解开已灭绝鳄鱼之谜
enrich.summary_zh: 研究者依据埃及 Mokattam 石灰岩（雕刻吉萨狮身人面像所用石材）中的头骨化石，命名了长吻鳄新种 Herugavialis cairensis，其眼窝边缘隆起等特征有别于现生马来鳄。长吻鳄曾能适应海洋并遍布全球，约600万年前的墨西拿盐度危机令地中海鳄类灭绝，这段历史警示当前气候危机同样可能留下持续数百万年的影响。

paragraphs.en: My colleagues and I discovered a new species of extinct crocodile from a fossil found in the same rocks used to carve the Great Sphinx of Giza.
paragraphs.zh: 我和同事们从一块化石中发现了一种已灭绝鳄鱼的新物种，这块化石出自当年用于雕刻吉萨大狮身人面像的同一种岩石。

paragraphs.en: Today, there are only two species of the long-snouted gavial crocodile, both of which are endangered: Gavialis gangeticus and Tomistoma schlegelii. They are found only in freshwater environments on the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia.
paragraphs.zh: 如今，长吻的鳄类——长吻鳄类（gavial）——只剩下两个物种，且均属濒危：恒河鳄（Gavialis gangeticus）和马来鳄（Tomistoma schlegelii）。它们仅分布于印度次大陆和东南亚的淡水环境中。

paragraphs.en: However, the fossil record of gavials goes back 80 million years, to the time of the dinosaurs. It shows that they were once diverse, with more than 40 species known, and lived all over the globe. So how did a group of crocodiles that today cannot tolerate saltwater once live all over the world? Our discovery may help to solve this puzzle.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，长吻鳄的化石记录可追溯至8000万年前，即恐龙时代。记录显示它们曾种类繁多，已知物种超过40种，且遍布全球。那么，一个今天连咸水都无法忍受的鳄类类群，当年是如何遍布世界的？我们的发现或许有助于解开这个谜题。

paragraphs.en: Although the distribution of the continents differed from today, most were already separated by oceans. My colleagues and I have been trying to understand how gavials achieved this cosmopolitan distribution, while also seeking to unlock what led to their current predicament.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管当时大陆的分布与今天不同，但多数大陆之间已被大洋隔开。我和同事们一直试图理解长吻鳄是如何实现这种全球分布的，同时也力图弄清是什么导致了它们今天的困境。

paragraphs.zh: 近年来，通过研究现生与化石长吻鳄骨骼的解剖结构，我们对这个类群的演化有了更深入的了解。CT扫描使我们得以观察它们的头骨内部，从而打开一扇窥探其大脑和感觉系统的窗口。

paragraphs.en: This has revealed new anatomical information that helps differentiate species, and has allowed us to infer aspects of the biology and ecology of some of the extinct species.
paragraphs.zh: 这揭示了新的解剖学信息，有助于区分不同物种，也让我们得以推断某些已灭绝物种在生物学和生态学上的一些特点。

paragraphs.en: For example, in an extinct group of crocodile relatives known to have lived entirely in the ocean, other researchers found thickening of the outer wall of their inner ear to cope with the higher pressures seen at ocean depths. My colleagues and I have found similar evidence for a marine lifestyle in some fossil gavials. This ability to live in the ocean was lost in living species, which are restricted to rivers and lakes.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，在一个已知完全生活在海洋中的已灭绝鳄类近亲类群中，其他研究者发现其内耳外壁增厚，以应对海洋深处更高的压力。我和同事们在一些化石长吻鳄身上也发现了类似的海生生活证据。这种在海洋中生活的能力在现生物种身上已经丧失，它们如今只局限于河流和湖泊。

paragraphs.en: Several of the gavial fossils we have been studying from Africa and Europe were first reported in the late 19th and early 20th centuries and they were often described as species of Tomistoma, i.e. closely related to Tomistoma schlegelii, one of the two living species of gavials. Our previous work and that of others has shown that some of these extinct species are not closely related to Tomistoma, with new names given for some of them. However, many of these historically described species remain neglected. Led by my former PhD student, Paul Burke, now a researcher at the Swedish Museum of Natural History in Stockholm, along with colleagues from Egypt and Germany, we re-examined one of these species in a new study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们一直在研究的若干来自非洲和欧洲的长吻鳄化石，最早是在19世纪末和20世纪初被报道的，它们常被描述为 Tomistoma 属的物种，即与现生两种长吻鳄之一马来鳄（Tomistoma schlegelii）亲缘关系很近。我们此前的研究以及他人的研究已表明，其中一些已灭绝物种与 Tomistoma 并不近缘，部分物种因此被赋予了新的名称。然而，许多历史上描述过的这类物种仍被忽视。在我以前的博士生、现为斯德哥尔摩瑞典自然历史博物馆研究员的保罗·伯克（Paul Burke）带领下，我们与来自埃及和德国的同事合作，在一项新研究中重新检视了其中一个物种。

paragraphs.en: In the 1920s, several fossils were collected from northeastern Egypt. These were found in a limestone rock, known as the Mokattam Formation, that had formed 45 million years ago in a shallow marine environment when sea levels were higher. This region was submerged at this time. These fossils, including a nearly complete skull, were described in 1927 as belonging to Tomistoma, because of their superficial resemblance to the living species, Tomistoma schlegelii.
paragraphs.zh: 20世纪20年代，人们在埃及东北部采集到若干化石。它们发现于一种名为“Mokattam 组”的石灰岩中，该岩层形成于4500万年前海平面较高时期的浅海环境。当时这一地区被海水淹没。这些化石（其中包括一个近乎完整的头骨）于1927年被描述为属于 Tomistoma 属，原因是它们与现生物种马来鳄有表面上的相似之处。

paragraphs.en: However, aided by the use of CT scanning, our team was able to identify several anatomical differences, including the presence of raised rims around the eye sockets, which are absent in Tomistoma.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，借助CT扫描，我们的团队识别出了若干解剖学差异，包括眼窝周围存在隆起的边缘，而这在 Tomistoma 属中是没有的。

paragraphs.en: The Great Sphinx of Giza. Fernanda-Belen/Shutterstock The Mokattam Formation already has a legacy: 4,500 years ago, these rocks were used to carve the Great Sphinx of Giza. The gavial skull shares more than this origin story though. Just as the Sphinx is famously missing the tip of its nose, the fossil is also missing the tip of its snout. This coincidence led us to name the new crocodile Herugavialis cairensis after the Egyptian falcon-headed god Heru (also known as Horus), who is often thought to be the inspiration for the iconic Sphinx.
paragraphs.zh: （题图：吉萨大狮身人面像。Fernanda-Belen/Shutterstock）Mokattam 组早已留下了一份遗产：4500年前，这些岩石被用来雕刻吉萨大狮身人面像。不过，这个长吻鳄头骨与它的渊源不止于此。正如狮身人面像以缺失鼻尖而闻名，这块化石同样缺失了吻部的前端。这一巧合促使我们将这种新鳄鱼命名为 Herugavialis cairensis，取自埃及隼头神荷鲁（Heru，即 Horus），人们常认为他正是这座标志性狮身人面像的灵感来源。

paragraphs.en: Both northern Africa and southern Europe hosted a high diversity of gavials (and other crocodiles) during much of the last 80 million years, with these species thriving in the shallow, marine environments that covered much of the Mediterranean region at the time.
paragraphs.zh: 在过去8000万年的大部分时间里，北非和南欧都拥有高度多样的长吻鳄（以及其他鳄类），这些物种在当年覆盖地中海地区大片区域的浅海环境中繁衍生息。

paragraphs.en: Unlike living gavials, it is likely that some of these species could cross oceans. This diversity appears to have persisted through the devastating mass extinction that wiped out the dinosaurs, and probably fluctuated during alternating warmer and cooler intervals over the next 60 million years, tied to higher and lower sea levels, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 与现生长吻鳄不同，其中一些物种很可能能够跨越海洋。这种多样性似乎一直延续过了那场消灭恐龙的毁灭性大灭绝，并在此后6000万年中随着温暖与寒冷交替的时期而起伏——暖期与冷期分别对应较高的和较低的海平面。

paragraphs.en: However, crocodiles disappeared from the Mediterranean region approximately 6 million years ago and never returned. Their demise coincides with an event known as the Messinian salinity crisis, when the Mediterranean essentially dried up as a result of being sealed off from the Atlantic Ocean. As the seawater became increasingly salty with the heightened evaporation of water, it would have become ever more intolerable to the animals inhabiting it, even those usually able to live in saltwater, leading to the loss of crocodiles and many other species.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，大约600万年前，鳄类从地中海地区消失，此后再未回归。它们的消亡与被称为“墨西拿盐度危机”的事件同时发生：当时地中海因与大西洋隔绝而基本干涸。随着水分蒸发加剧，海水变得越来越咸，对栖息其中的动物而言也越来越难以忍受——即便是通常能生活在咸水中的动物也不例外——最终导致鳄类和许多其他物种的消失。

paragraphs.en: The signature of this event can still be observed today, with the Mediterranean Sea still much saltier than the oceans, and crocodiles entirely absent from this region. The remaining living gavials live far away from the Mediterranean, but the loss of the adaptations that would allow them to live in saltwater means that they would not be able to survive there regardless.
paragraphs.zh: 这一事件的印记至今仍然可见：地中海至今仍比大洋咸得多，而鳄类在该地区完全缺席。现存的长吻鳄生活在远离地中海的地方，但它们已经丧失了使自身能够在咸水中生存的适应特征，这意味着即便把它们放到那里，它们也无法存活。

paragraphs.en: Rapid and extreme changes in temperature, sea level, and aridification are critical components of the current climate emergency, and events such as the Messinian salinity crisis show that they can have a lasting impact on biodiversity, spanning millions of years.
paragraphs.zh: 气温、海平面和干旱化的急剧而极端的变化，是当前气候紧急状态的关键组成部分；而像墨西拿盐度危机这样的事件表明，这些变化能够对生物多样性产生跨越数百万年的持久影响。

vocab.meaning_zh: 长吻鳄（恒河鳄类），嘴部细长的鳄类；文中指包括恒河鳄和马来鳄在内的一个类群
vocab.example_en: Only two species of gavial survive today, both endangered.
vocab.example_zh: 如今仅存两种长吻鳄，且都濒临灭绝。

vocab.meaning_zh: 全球分布，世界性分布（cosmopolitan 此处不是“大都市的”）
vocab.example_en: The fossil record shows a cosmopolitan distribution of the group 80 million years ago.
vocab.example_zh: 化石记录显示，该群体在8000万年前呈全球分布。

vocab.meaning_zh: 困境，窘境（此处指濒危、分布范围极度收缩的处境）
vocab.example_en: The two surviving species face a similar predicament.
vocab.example_zh: 现存的两个物种面临相似的困境。

vocab.meaning_zh: 推断，推论（根据间接证据得出结论）
vocab.example_en: From the skull's inner ear we can infer how the animal lived.
vocab.example_zh: 从头骨的内耳结构，我们可以推断这种动物的生活方式。

vocab.meaning_zh: 表面上的相似（实际未必近缘）
vocab.example_en: The 1927 study grouped the fossil with Tomistoma on the basis of superficial resemblance.
vocab.example_zh: 1927年的研究仅凭表面上的相似，就把这块化石归入了 Tomistoma 属。

vocab.meaning_zh: （鳄、猪等的）吻部，口鼻部

vocab.example_zh: 这块化石缺失了吻部的前端。

vocab.meaning_zh: 波动，起伏不定
vocab.example_en: Crocodile diversity fluctuated with rising and falling sea levels.
vocab.example_zh: 鳄类的多样性随海平面的升降而起伏。

vocab.meaning_zh: 与……同时发生；（时间上）恰好吻合
vocab.example_en: Their disappearance coincides with a period of extreme evaporation.
vocab.example_zh: 它们的消失与一段蒸发极强烈的时期恰好同时发生。

vocab.meaning_zh: 盐度，含盐量
vocab.example_en: The Mediterranean's high salinity is a legacy of that crisis.
vocab.example_zh: 地中海的高盐度是那场危机留下的遗产。

vocab.meaning_zh: 干旱化，变干过程
vocab.example_en: Aridification can reshape ecosystems for millions of years.

sentences.en: Several of the gavial fossils we have been studying from Africa and Europe were first reported in the late 19th and early 20th centuries and they were often described as species of Tomistoma, i.e. closely related to Tomistoma schlegelii, one of the two living species of gavials.
sentences.structure: 主干：Several of the gavial fossils … were first reported … and they were often described as species of Tomistoma。修饰：we have been studying from Africa and Europe 是省略了 that/which 的定语从句，后置修饰 fossils；i.e. closely related to Tomistoma schlegelii 是补充说明 Tomistoma 的同位语（相当于 which are closely related…）；one of the two living species of gavials 又是 Tomistoma schlegelii 的同位语。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句用 and 并列两个被动结构，交代了“化石被谁、在何时、以什么方式被描述”的研究史，为下文“旧分类需要修正”埋下伏笔。英文里同位语可以一层套一层（Tomistoma → schlegelii → one of the two living species），中文若照搬会非常拗口，所以译文用“即……”把层级拉平，符合汉语的表达习惯。遇到这种长句，先抓主谓（fossils were reported / they were described），再把插入的补充成分剥出来单独处理。

sentences.en: Just as the Sphinx is famously missing the tip of its nose, the fossil is also missing the tip of its snout.
sentences.structure: 主干：the fossil is also missing the tip of its snout。修饰：Just as… 引导比较状语从句，与主句构成“正如……同样……”的对应；famously 是副词作状语，意为“众所周知地”。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这是科普写作中典型的类比句：用读者熟悉的狮身人面像“缺鼻子”来解释化石“缺吻端”，既降低了理解门槛，又为下文以荷鲁斯命名做铺垫。注意 is missing 用进行体表示“处于缺失状态”，是状态而非动作。翻译时保留“正如……同样……”的对应结构，才能保住原文的修辞意图。

sentences.en: As the seawater became increasingly salty with the heightened evaporation of water, it would have become ever more intolerable to the animals inhabiting it, even those usually able to live in saltwater, leading to the loss of crocodiles and many other species.
sentences.structure: 主干：it would have become ever more intolerable (to the animals)。修饰：As… 引导时间兼原因状语从句；with the heightened evaporation of water 是介词短语，说明变咸的原因；inhabiting it 是现在分词短语作后置定语，修饰 animals；even those usually able to live in saltwater 是 animals 的同位语（those = the animals，able to… 为形容词短语后置）；leading to… 是现在分词短语作结果状语，修饰整个主句。
sentences.analysis_zh: would have become 是“情态动词 + have done”，表示对过去情形的推断，译为“想必会变得……”，不能译成“将来”。前半句把“越来越咸”和“越来越难以忍受”用 increasingly / ever more 两个递进结构对应起来，翻译时中文也宜用“越来越……越来越……”来复制这种同步推进的节奏。句末的 leading to 结果是全句最终导向，中文拆成“最终导致……”独立成句最清晰。

background.title: 吉萨大狮身人面像与 Mokattam 石灰岩
background.text_zh: 大狮身人面像位于埃及吉萨金字塔群旁，约建于4500年前的古王国时期，是在原地裸露的石灰岩基岩上雕凿而成的，而非用外来石料砌筑。这层岩石属于始新世的 Mokattam 组，形成于数千万年前的浅海环境，因而含有大量海洋生物化石。正因为建造雕像所用的岩层本身就是海相沉积岩，古生物学家才能在同一套地层里发现海生鳄类的头骨化石——文章标题所说的“狮身人面像帮助解谜”，指的就是这个地质上的巧合。原文中提到雕像缺鼻子，这是长期风化与人为破坏共同造成的，也是它最广为人知的特征之一。

background.title: 墨西拿盐度危机（Messinian salinity crisis）
background.text_zh: 约596万年前，由于非洲板块与欧亚板块碰撞，直布罗陀海峡一带被封闭，地中海与大西洋断绝水体交换。在强烈的蒸发作用下，地中海几乎完全干涸，海底沉积出厚厚的岩盐与石膏层，这就是地质学上的“墨西拿盐度危机”。直到约533万年前海峡重新打开，大西洋海水再次灌入，地中海才恢复原状。这一事件造成原有海洋生物大量灭绝，也让地中海至今仍是盐度明显高于大洋的水体。它常被用作“地理隔绝 + 环境剧变导致生物多样性崩溃”的经典案例，作者正是借此类比当下的气候危机。

title_en: How a Secret Vote by U.N. Scientists Legitimized Carbon Capture and Skewed Decades of Climate Policy
excerpt_en: The post How a Secret Vote by U.N. Scientists Legitimized Carbon Capture and Skewed Decades of Climate Policy appeared first on ProPublica.
body_en: Illustration by Chris W. Kim for ProPublica From the series Carbon Captured: How the fossil fuel industry influence climate research, an investigation from ProPublica and Drilled

In the spring of 2005, the United Nations convened more than 100 of the world’s top scientists in the medieval town of Oviedo, Spain. They were there to finish writing a paradigm-shifting report about a technology that they hoped could help stop climate change.

To celebrate the report’s impending completion, the meeting’s hosts handed out bottles of cava, Spanish sparkling wine, with tongue-in-cheek labels stating that they were to be opened only by those who truly believed it could work.

Belief was necessary because the technology — carbon capture and storage, or CCS — had barely been tested. The idea was simple: strip carbon dioxide from smokestacks before it could flow into the air and warm the planet. Then pump it into a porous part of the Earth’s crust and leave it there. Forever.

The experts in Oviedo had stacks of papers proving that parts of the process worked. But major questions remained about how much space exists inside the Earth to store the CO2, how effectively it could be monitored and whether the poisonous, concentrated gas would reliably stay underground.

Tasked with wrangling roughly three dozen of those scientists toward consensus was Sally Benson, a geoscientist from Lawrence Berkeley National Lab who was co-leading the report’s chapter on underground storage of carbon. After a quarter-century of studying how fluids and gases move beneath Earth’s surface, she was an unimpeachable authority on the subject. She was also a savvy and diplomatic leader, skilled at managing rooms full of big egos and big tempers. It was proving handy in a process that had at times devolved into unruly debate.

The scientists had clashed for years over what the report should say, first at a meeting in Canada, then in Norway, Australia and Brazil. The evidence was scant. Three large-scale experiments were underway, but only one — a Norwegian operation that captured carbon from a natural gas field and pumped it under the bed of the North Sea — had rigorously tested permanent storage. There, the injected CO2 astonished engineers when it floated 700 feet upward through a series of geologic formations. To their relief, it hit a ceiling of shale that kept it underground, and the project was deemed a success. But with so little to go on, the scientists warned in their first draft that any broad statement about leakage risk would be “almost meaningless.”

The researchers were in Oviedo only because Saudi Arabia and other oil-exporting countries had pressured the U.N. to write the report despite the paucity of evidence, according to U.N. officials and records. The oil, gas and coal industries had spent years casting doubt on climate change while quietly fretting that policies to address it would one day put them out of business. The industry, documents show, saw CCS as a way to forestall that outcome, allowing the world to keep burning fossil fuels while simply burying the pollution underground. A U.N. report would bring the technology into the mainstream.

In turn, the U.N. hoped such a report would draw the oil-producing nations into its search for climate solutions. So despite objections from some nations and environmental organizations, which warned that the report would distract from the imperative to phase out fossil fuels, the U.N.’s preeminent climate science authority, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, went ahead. And for the first time, it invited a large contingent of industry researchers to join the scientists in writing the report, as well as several representatives from environmental groups. Benson’s chapter included authors and editors from Shell, Chevron and Saudi Aramco.

The process that followed would make some of the chapter’s scientists uneasy. The IPCC’s procedures stated that reports should assess the existing research on a topic based on peer-reviewed literature and that exceptions must be reviewed and clearly cited.

Bert Metz, one of the highest-ranking U.N. officials at the meeting, was pressing the group to come up with more definitive language about CCS’ potential. The report would be better if it could offer hard numbers, even where none existed in the literature: Precisely how many gigatons of storage capacity did the planet likely have? How long would a well-designed reservoir hold the CO2 injected into it? More than a year? A thousand years?

With so little evidence to work with, David Keith, a Canadian physicist, proposed a workaround: The authors could conduct an “expert elicitation,” taking an anonymous survey about what they expected the evidence to eventually show.

At first, not everyone was willing to go along. Some scientists worried that making what amounted to educated guesses would mislead the public, they told Drilled and ProPublica. Benson and Metz, though, both argued that on such an important matter informed advice was better than nothing.

In the end, the group agreed to take the survey and to keep it off the record — they would “burn it afterward,” Keith recounted, making no mention of it in the official report. When the meeting concluded, some of the scientists popped their bottles of cava in celebration.
“It’s not the hard science that you would prefer, obviously,” Metz would later tell Drilled and ProPublica.
Five months later, the IPCC published its special report, which would help legitimize CCS for a generation.

The 431-page document portrayed CCS as a potential savior for the climate that could enable countries “to continue to include fossil fuels in their energy mix.” It stated that using CCS could lower the cost of stabilizing global CO2 concentrations by at least 30% and that if fully supported by policy, it could account for as much as 55% of the world’s efforts to limit climate change through this century.

enrich.title_zh: 联合国科学家的一次秘密投票，如何让碳捕集获得正当性，并让气候政策偏离数十年
enrich.summary_zh: 2005年，联合国气候科学机构在西班牙奥维耶多敲定一份关于碳捕集与封存（CCS）的报告。在证据匮乏、产油国施压的背景下，IPCC 首次邀请壳牌、雪佛龙、沙特阿美等企业研究人员参与撰写；为凑出关键数字，作者们做了一次不留记录的匿名专家调查。这份431页的报告把 CCS 塑造为气候救星，为其赢得长达一代人的正当性。

But major questions remained about how much space exists inside the Earth to store the CO2, how effectively it could be monitored and whether the poisonous, concentrated gas would reliably stay underground.
paragraphs.zh: 奥维耶多的专家们手头有一摞摞论文，证明这一流程中的某些环节确实可行。但重大问题依然悬而未决：地球内部究竟有多少空间可以用来封存二氧化碳？它能被多有效地监测？这种有毒的、高浓度的气体能否可靠地留在地下？

paragraphs.zh: 负责把其中约三十几位科学家撮合到共识上来的，是来自劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室的地球科学家萨莉·本森（Sally Benson），她参与主持了报告中关于碳的地下封存那一章。她研究了二十五年流体与气体如何在地表之下运动，是这个领域无可指摘的权威。她同时也是位精明而善于周旋的领导者，擅长安抚一屋子自负而火爆的人。在这一时而沦为混乱争吵的过程中，这一点显得格外管用。

paragraphs.en: The scientists had clashed for years over what the report should say, first at a meeting in Canada, then in Norway, Australia and Brazil. The evidence was scant. Three large-scale experiments were underway, but only one — a Norwegian operation that captured carbon from a natural gas field and pumped it under the bed of the North Sea — had rigorously tested permanent storage. To their relief, it hit a ceiling of shale that kept it underground, and the project was deemed a success. But with so little to go on, the scientists warned in their first draft that any broad statement about leakage risk would be “almost meaningless.”
paragraphs.zh: 多年来，科学家们一直为报告该怎么写而争执：先是在加拿大的一次会议上，之后又在挪威、澳大利亚和巴西。证据十分稀少。当时有三项大型试验正在进行，但只有一项——挪威的一个项目，从天然气田捕集二氧化碳并注入北海海床之下——对永久封存做过严格检验。在那里，注入的二氧化碳向上浮升了700英尺，穿过一连串地质构造，令工程师们大为吃惊。所幸它撞上一层页岩“天花板”，被挡在了地下，项目因此被认为取得成功。但可供依据的东西实在太少，科学家们在初稿中警告说，任何关于泄漏风险的笼统说法都“几乎是毫无意义的”。

paragraphs.en: The researchers were in Oviedo only because Saudi Arabia and other oil-exporting countries had pressured the U.N. to write the report despite the paucity of evidence, according to U.N. officials and records. The oil, gas and coal industries had spent years casting doubt on climate change while quietly fretting that policies to address it would one day put them out of business. The industry, documents show, saw CCS as a way to forestall that outcome, allowing the world to keep burning fossil fuels while simply burying the pollution underground. A U.N. report would bring the technology into the mainstream.
paragraphs.zh: 据联合国官员和档案记载，这些研究人员之所以会聚奥维耶多，只是因为沙特阿拉伯和其他石油出口国在证据如此匮乏的情况下仍向联合国施压，要求撰写这份报告。石油、天然气和煤炭行业多年来一直在给气候变化打问号，同时私下担心有朝一日应对气候变化的政策会让他们关门大吉。文件显示，该行业把 CCS 视为规避这一结局的途径：世界可以继续烧化石燃料，只要把污染埋到地下就行。而一份联合国报告，会把这项技术带进主流。

paragraphs.en: In turn, the U.N. hoped such a report would draw the oil-producing nations into its search for climate solutions. So despite objections from some nations and environmental organizations, which warned that the report would distract from the imperative to phase out fossil fuels, the U.N.’s preeminent climate science authority, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, went ahead. And for the first time, it invited a large contingent of industry researchers to join the scientists in writing the report, as well as several representatives from environmental groups. Benson’s chapter included authors and editors from Shell, Chevron and Saudi Aramco.
paragraphs.zh: 反过来，联合国也希望这样一份报告能把产油国拉进它寻找气候解决方案的努力中来。因此，尽管一些国家和环保组织提出反对——它们警告说，这份报告会分散人们对“必须逐步淘汰化石燃料”这一当务之急的注意力——联合国最权威的气候科学机构政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）还是推进了这项工作。它首次邀请了一大批产业界研究人员与科学家共同撰写报告，还邀请了几位环保组织的代表。本森负责的那一章，作者和编辑中就有来自壳牌、雪佛龙和沙特阿美的人。

paragraphs.en: The process that followed would make some of the chapter’s scientists uneasy. The IPCC’s procedures stated that reports should assess the existing research on a topic based on peer-reviewed literature and that exceptions must be reviewed and clearly cited.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来的过程让这一章的部分科学家感到不安。IPCC 的程序规定，报告应当依据经过同行评审的文献来评估某个议题的现有研究，例外情况必须经过审查并明确标注出处。

paragraphs.en: Bert Metz, one of the highest-ranking U.N. officials at the meeting, was pressing the group to come up with more definitive language about CCS’ potential. The report would be better if it could offer hard numbers, even where none existed in the literature: Precisely how many gigatons of storage capacity did the planet likely have? How long would a well-designed reservoir hold the CO2 injected into it? More than a year? A thousand years?
paragraphs.zh: 会议上级别最高的联合国官员之一伯特·梅茨（Bert Metz）不断施压，要求小组就 CCS 的潜力给出更确定的表述。报告如果能提供确切的数字会更好，哪怕文献里根本没有这些数字：地球究竟可能有多少吉吨的封存容量？一个设计良好的封存层能把注入的二氧化碳留住多久？一年以上？还是一千年？

paragraphs.en: With so little evidence to work with, David Keith, a Canadian physicist, proposed a workaround: The authors could conduct an “expert elicitation,” taking an anonymous survey about what they expected the evidence to eventually show.
paragraphs.zh: 由于可供利用的证据实在太少，加拿大物理学家戴维·基思（David Keith）提出了一个变通办法：作者们可以做一次“专家判断征集”（expert elicitation），用匿名问卷的方式征询他们认为证据最终会显示什么。

paragraphs.en: At first, not everyone was willing to go along. Some scientists worried that making what amounted to educated guesses would mislead the public, they told Drilled and ProPublica. Benson and Metz, though, both argued that on such an important matter informed advice was better than nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 起初并不是所有人都愿意配合。一些科学家告诉 Drilled 和 ProPublica，他们担心这种说到底是“有根据的猜测”的东西会误导公众。不过本森和梅茨都主张，在如此重要的问题上，有依据的建议总比什么都没有强。

paragraphs.en: In the end, the group agreed to take the survey and to keep it off the record — they would “burn it afterward,” Keith recounted, making no mention of it in the official report. When the meeting concluded, some of the scientists popped their bottles of cava in celebration.
paragraphs.zh: 最终，小组同意做这项调查，并约定不留下任何记录——用基思的话说，他们“事后会把它烧掉”，官方报告中对它只字未提。会议结束时，一些科学家开瓶畅饮卡瓦起泡酒，以示庆祝。

paragraphs.en: “It’s not the hard science that you would prefer, obviously,” Metz would later tell Drilled and ProPublica.
paragraphs.zh: “显然，这不是你更希望看到的那种硬科学。”梅茨后来对 Drilled 和 ProPublica 说。

paragraphs.en: Five months later, the IPCC published its special report, which would help legitimize CCS for a generation.
paragraphs.zh: 五个月后，IPCC 发布了这份特别报告，它在此后一代人的时间里帮助 CCS 获得了正当性。

paragraphs.en: The 431-page document portrayed CCS as a potential savior for the climate that could enable countries “to continue to include fossil fuels in their energy mix.” It stated that using CCS could lower the cost of stabilizing global CO2 concentrations by at least 30% and that if fully supported by policy, it could account for as much as 55% of the world’s efforts to limit climate change through this century.
paragraphs.zh: 这份431页的文件把 CCS 描绘成气候的潜在救星，能让各国“继续把化石燃料留在本国能源结构中”。它称，使用 CCS 可使稳定全球二氧化碳浓度的成本至少降低30%；如果得到政策的全面支持，到本世纪末，它可承担全球限制气候变化努力中的多达55%。

vocab.meaning_zh: （思维或研究框架）发生根本性转变的；开创性的。外刊评论重大研究时的高频修饰语。
vocab.example_en: The discovery was described as paradigm-shifting for the field of immunology.
vocab.example_zh: 这一发现被形容为免疫学领域的一次范式转变。

vocab.meaning_zh: 半开玩笑的、不必当真的。常用于形容看似郑重实为调侃的措辞。
vocab.example_en: The company’s tongue-in-cheek slogan was taken seriously by some investors.
vocab.example_zh: 这家公司半开玩笑的口号，被一些投资者当了真。

vocab.meaning_zh: 多孔的、有孔隙可渗透的。文中指能容纳二氧化碳的岩层。
vocab.example_en: The engineers pumped the gas into porous sandstone deep below the seabed.
vocab.example_zh: 工程师把气体注入海床深处多孔的砂岩层。

vocab.meaning_zh: （费力地）劝说、周旋、把……协调到某个结果上；也可指长时间争吵。wrangle sb. toward consensus 是形象的外刊用法。
vocab.example_en: It took months to wrangle the committee toward a compromise.
vocab.example_zh: 把委员会周旋到一份妥协方案上，花了几个月时间。

vocab.meaning_zh: 无可指摘的、无可置疑的（多形容权威、品行、来源）。
vocab.example_en: She is an unimpeachable authority on the chemistry of deep-sea sediments.
vocab.example_zh: 在深海沉积物化学这一领域，她是无可置疑的权威。

vocab.meaning_zh: （数量上）稀少的、几乎不够用的，常含“不足以支撑结论”的意味。
vocab.example_en: Evidence for the treatment’s long-term benefits remains scant.
vocab.example_zh: 支持这种疗法长期获益的证据依然稀少。

vocab.meaning_zh: （与 of 连用）缺乏、不足。比 lack 更书面、更正式，是政策与学术报道的高频词。
vocab.example_en: The report was commissioned despite a paucity of peer-reviewed data.
vocab.example_zh: 尽管同行评审数据匮乏，这份报告的编写仍被委托启动。

vocab.meaning_zh: 预先阻止、抢先把……挡住。文中指行业想“抢先规避”被政策淘汰的结局。
vocab.example_en: The industry lobbied hard to forestall stricter emission rules.
vocab.example_zh: 该行业大力游说，力图预先阻止更严格的排放法规出台。

vocab.meaning_zh: （信息、判断的）引出、征集。expert elicitation 是专业术语，指在没有充分数据时系统征询专家主观判断的方法。
vocab.example_en: The authors resorted to expert elicitation to estimate the missing figures.
vocab.example_zh: 作者们借助专家判断征集来估算缺失的数字。

vocab.meaning_zh: 不供发表地、不留记录地。文中指这场调查被刻意排除在正式记录之外。
vocab.example_en: He spoke off the record, on condition that nothing be attributed to him.
vocab.example_zh: 他以不供发表为条件发言，要求不得把他的名字与任何内容挂钩。

sentences.en: Tasked with wrangling roughly three dozen of those scientists toward consensus was Sally Benson, a geoscientist from Lawrence Berkeley National Lab who was co-leading the report’s chapter on underground storage of carbon.
sentences.structure: 主干：（倒装）表语 Tasked with... + 系动词 was + 主语 Sally Benson。修饰：同位语 a geoscientist from Lawrence Berkeley National Lab 说明身份；who 引导定语从句修饰 a geoscientist，说明其职责。

sentences.en: So despite objections from some nations and environmental organizations, which warned that the report would distract from the imperative to phase out fossil fuels, the U.N.’s preeminent climate science authority, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, went ahead.
sentences.structure: 主干：the IPCC went ahead。修饰：So 承接上文的连接副词；despite objections... 为让步状语，其中 which 引导非限制性定语从句修饰 objections，that 引导宾语从句作 warned 的宾语；the U.N.’s preeminent climate science authority 是主语的同位语，与 the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change 同位。

sentences.en: It stated that using CCS could lower the cost of stabilizing global CO2 concentrations by at least 30% and that if fully supported by policy, it could account for as much as 55% of the world’s efforts to limit climate change through this century.
sentences.structure: 主干：It stated + 两个并列的 that 宾语从句（that... and that...）。第一个从句：using CCS（动名词作主语）could lower the cost of stabilizing...，by at least 30% 为程度状语修饰 lower；第二个从句：if fully supported by policy 为省略形式的条件状语从句，it could account for as much as 55% of...，through this century 为时间状语。

background.title: IPCC 与《二氧化碳捕集与封存特别报告》
background.text_zh: 政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）由联合国环境规划署和世界气象组织于1988年共同设立，本身不做实验，只对已发表的文献做评估。它除定期发布评估报告外，还应成员国要求编写“特别报告”。文中这场2005年的奥维耶多会议，正是为了定稿《二氧化碳捕集与封存特别报告》（SRCCS）。IPCC 有一条特殊规则：报告正文由科学家撰写，但“决策者摘要”须由各国政府代表逐行审议通过——这意味着产油国政府在文本定调上有直接的发言权，这也是文中“产油国施压”能奏效的制度背景。报告一旦发布，即成为各国政策、碳市场与气候谈判的通用参考，所以“正当性”效应能持续很久。

background.title: CCS 是什么，为什么化石燃料行业力挺它
background.text_zh: 碳捕集与封存（CCS）指在发电厂、水泥厂、天然气处理等排放源把二氧化碳分离出来，经管道或船舶运输后注入深层咸水层或枯竭油气田长期封存。它技术链条长、成本高、能耗大，且封存环节的长期泄漏风险难以用短周期实验验证——这正是文中科学家为难的地方。对石油公司而言，CCS 还有一重现实好处：注入的二氧化碳可用于“强化采油”（EOR），把难以开采的原油驱赶出来，因而减排投入可以转化为产量。对产油国来说，CCS 提供了一套话语：不必削减化石燃料产量，只需处理排放。这一“技术中立”的外衣，是它能进入联合国报告并影响此后数十年气候政策讨论的关键。

title_en: Federal and State Officials Ramp Up Scrutiny of DraftKings, Other Sports Betting Apps
excerpt_en: The post Federal and State Officials Ramp Up Scrutiny of DraftKings, Other Sports Betting Apps appeared first on ProPublica.
body_en: Connecticut Sen. Richard Blumenthal, one of three federal lawmakers who recently cited ProPublica reporting in a letter asking sports betting companies for more information about their business practices. Tom Williams/CQ-Roll Call, Inc via Getty Images State and federal officials have ramped up scrutiny of online sports betting companies in recent weeks, launching inquiries, demanding information and, in one case, proposing a new rule that would limit when companies like DraftKings can pitch their users to bet more.

The moves — by gaming regulators, government lawyers and federal lawmakers — follow an investigation last month by ProPublica that tested the guardrails DraftKings and other sports betting companies have in place to protect users from spiraling out of control. That system is called responsible gaming, and executives say it’s integral to their companies’ long-term success.

The ProPublica article showed how DraftKings bestowed VIP status on a reporter who deliberately bet like a problem gambler. The report detailed the ways in which the app’s user design and promotions encouraged more betting — even after the reporter opted into responsible gaming tools designed to slow users down. A week earlier, The New York Times reported that DraftKings had used machine learning and artificial intelligence to target promotions to losing bettors.

Those articles were the focus of an Oct. 15 meeting of the Louisiana Gaming Control Board, which, partly in response to the stories, tabled the renewal of DraftKings’ five-year license. Instead, the board granted the company a temporary four-month permit while investigators look into the issues raised in the reports as well as other paperwork concerns.
The board’s chair, Christopher Hebert, said the Times had raised some “very serious questions” and called ProPublica’s reporting “very troubling.”

While news stories “are not findings of regulatory violations,” Hebert said, “as regulators we have a responsibility to examine these matters that could affect the integrity of gaming operations and the protections of our citizens here in Louisiana.”

State health officials say the number of Louisianans believed to have a gambling disorder has risen in recent years amid the surge in popularity of online gambling and prediction market sites. One top official reported this summer that gambling addiction was among the health department’s “top three priorities.”

What Does Your Data Reveal About Sports Betting Apps? Help ProPublica Find Out. If you’ve bet on sports with FanDuel or DraftKings, you can help ProPublica understand how these apps work. Use our browser extension to download your betting history, then upload your files.

Share Your Experience Paul Liberman, who co-founded DraftKings and serves as its president of operations, told the regulators: “We do not use artificial intelligence to target losing gamblers by any means.”

DraftKings previously told ProPublica that it proactively closes the accounts of suspected problem gamblers “all the time” but declined to provide specific figures. Yet when asked by a Louisiana board member for those same specifics, Lori Kalani, DraftKings’ chief responsible gaming officer, said 175 accounts in the state had been shut down this year. She told the board she didn’t know how many total users DraftKings had in the Pelican State.

“We’re not physicians, we’re not clinicians and that’s not our role, but we certainly want to help people enjoy the service, the platform that we’re offering them,” Kalani told the board. “I know that we’re doing our job and that when we see something, we say something and we engage. I just can’t tell you if 175 is the right number. I wish it was zero.”

In a statement, a DraftKings spokesperson said: “As a legal, regulated operator, DraftKings values an open and ongoing dialogue with regulators and regular conversations and check-ins with regulators are normal course of business.”

In response to ProPublica’s original investigation, Kalani said DraftKings’ responsible gaming system — which consists largely of in-app messages about the company’s tools — “worked the way it was supposed to.” She cautioned against “drawing broad conclusions” from one user’s experience.

The day after the Louisiana meeting, regulators in Ohio proposed an amendment to the state’s sports gaming rule that would bar companies like DraftKings from sending direct ads or marketing to bettors for 48 hours after they’d opted into responsible gaming tools or updated their current settings.

The proposed amendment speaks directly to a finding in ProPublica’s reporting: After blowing nearly $4,500 betting on tennis in 24 hours, the reporter used such tools to limit the amount of time and money he could spend on the app. Just 30 minutes later, though, he received the first of four push notifications promoting new betting opportunities. It wasn’t until he opted into a far more restrictive tool, called a “cool-off,” that the notifications temporarily stopped.

Andromeda Morrison, the interim executive director of the Ohio Casino Control Commission, said that though her office had been working on its proposal for some time, ProPublica’s story illuminated the issue. “Hopefully this is something that is fairly easy for the industry to see as a common sense restriction to make sure those consumers are making good choices without those push notifications,” she said.

But Keith Whyte, a former director of the National Council on Problem Gambling who now consults for industry and nonprofit groups, said the proposed amendment could unintentionally disincentivize users from using tools like deposit limits. “I think the implication is that using a responsible gaming tool is a sign of a gambling problem,” he said. The measure faces a long rulemaking process, including more rounds of public hearings and comments.

paragraphs.zh: 在一份声明中，DraftKings的一位发言人说：“作为一家合法、受监管的运营商，DraftKings重视与监管者之间公开、持续的对话，与监管者定期沟通和汇报属于正常业务范畴。”

paragraphs.en: But Keith Whyte, a former director of the National Council on Problem Gambling who now consults for industry and nonprofit groups, said the proposed amendment could unintentionally disincentivize users from using tools like deposit limits. “I think the implication is that using a responsible gaming tool is a sign of a gambling problem,” he said. The measure faces a long rulemaking process, including more rounds of public hearings and comments.
paragraphs.zh: 但基思·怀特（Keith Whyte）——美国问题赌博全国委员会前主任，现为行业机构和非营利组织提供咨询——表示，这项拟议修正案可能会无意中打击用户使用存款限额等工具的积极性。“我认为其隐含意思是，使用负责任博彩工具是赌博问题的标志，”他说。该措施还要经历漫长的规则制定程序，包括更多轮公开听证和意见征集。

vocab.meaning_zh: （在规模或强度上）加大、增强
vocab.example_en: Regulators have ramped up scrutiny of online betting apps.
vocab.example_zh: 监管机构已加大对在线博彩应用的审查力度。

vocab.meaning_zh: 严密审查、仔细审视（外刊高频，常与 come under / intensify 搭配）
vocab.example_en: The company came under intense scrutiny after the investigation.
vocab.example_zh: 调查之后，该公司受到严密审查。

vocab.meaning_zh: 护栏；（比喻）防护机制、限制措施
vocab.example_en: The industry says it has guardrails to protect vulnerable users.
vocab.example_zh: 业界称其设有保护脆弱用户的防护机制。

vocab.meaning_zh: 失控并不断恶化（spiral 原指螺旋式上升/下降）
vocab.example_en: Small losses can quickly spiral out of control.
vocab.example_zh: 小额亏损可能迅速失控、越滚越大。

vocab.meaning_zh: 授予、给予（正式用语，常与 on/upon 连用）
vocab.example_en: The app bestowed VIP status on the new user within days.
vocab.example_zh: 这款应用几天内就授予该新用户VIP身份。

vocab.meaning_zh: （美式用法）搁置、暂缓审议（议案、申请）——熟词僻义，注意英式英语中 table 反而有“提出”之意
vocab.example_en: The board tabled the renewal of the license.
vocab.example_zh: 委员会搁置了该牌照的续期。

vocab.meaning_zh: 选择加入、主动启用（与 opt out 相反）
vocab.example_en: Users can opt into tools that limit their deposit amounts.
vocab.example_zh: 用户可以主动启用限制存款金额的工具。

vocab.meaning_zh: 照亮；使（问题）变得清晰、凸显出来
vocab.example_en: The reporting illuminated a gap in the state's rules.
vocab.example_zh: 这组报道凸显了该州规则中的一处空白。

vocab.meaning_zh: 使失去动力、抑制……的积极性（incentive 的反向构词）
vocab.example_en: The rule could disincentivize users from setting limits.
vocab.example_zh: 这项规定可能会让用户不愿设置限额。

vocab.meaning_zh: （定期）沟通、汇报、联络
vocab.example_en: Regular check-ins with regulators are normal course of business.
vocab.example_zh: 与监管机构定期沟通属于正常业务。

sentences.en: The day after the Louisiana meeting, regulators in Ohio proposed an amendment to the state’s sports gaming rule that would bar companies like DraftKings from sending direct ads or marketing to bettors for 48 hours after they’d opted into responsible gaming tools or updated their current settings.
sentences.structure: 主干：regulators in Ohio proposed an amendment（主谓宾）。修饰：to the state’s sports gaming rule 是介词短语作定语，说明是哪部规则的修正案；that would bar ... 是定语从句修饰 amendment；从句内部 bar sb. from doing sth. 为固定搭配；for 48 hours 是时间状语；after they’d opted into ... or updated ... 是时间状语从句，用过去完成时强调“先启用、后打广告”的先后顺序。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句是典型的新闻长句：主干极短（俄亥俄监管者提出修正案），信息量全压在后置定语和状语上。翻译时中文宜拆成“提出一项修正案……将禁止……”的连动结构，避免把定语从句硬塞进“的”字短语里。

sentences.en: Those articles were the focus of an Oct. 15 meeting of the Louisiana Gaming Control Board, which, partly in response to the stories, tabled the renewal of DraftKings’ five-year license.
sentences.structure: 主干：Those articles were the focus（主系表）。修饰：of an Oct. 15 meeting of the Louisiana Gaming Control Board 层层介词短语限定 focus；which ... 是非限制性定语从句修饰 the board；从句中 partly in response to the stories 是插入的状语，插在主语 which 和谓语 tabled 之间。
sentences.analysis_zh: 注意 which 指代的是委员会而非会议；插入状语故意放在主谓之间，是为了让“回应报道”这一因果关系紧贴先行词。tabled 在此为美式“搁置”，若读成英式“提出”会完全误解整段。

sentences.en: But Keith Whyte, a former director of the National Council on Problem Gambling who now consults for industry and nonprofit groups, said the proposed amendment could unintentionally disincentivize users from using tools like deposit limits.
sentences.structure: 主干：Keith Whyte said (that) ...。修饰：a former director ... 是同位语，who now consults for ... 是定语从句，二者都后置修饰主语；宾语从句中 the proposed amendment 作主语，could disincentivize 作谓语，users 作宾语，from using tools like deposit limits 是介词短语说明“在哪方面失去动力”。
sentences.analysis_zh: 外刊介绍人物时惯用“姓名 + 同位语 + 定语从句”三件套，把身份、履历一次交代清楚，中文宜拆成破折号或“现任……的前主任”来处理。disincentivize sb. from doing 是理解本句的关键搭配，意为“使某人不愿做某事”。

background.title: 美国体育博彩的州级监管格局
background.text_zh: 2018年美国最高法院在 Murphy v. NCAA 案中推翻1992年《职业与业余体育保护法》，联邦层面禁止体育博彩的规定失效，各州可自行立法开放并设立监管机构。此后 DraftKings、FanDuel 等在线平台迅速扩张。因此，对博彩公司的牌照发放、广告投放、负责任博彩措施的监管权主要在州一级（如文中路易斯安那州博彩控制委员会、俄亥俄州赌场控制委员会），联邦议员则多以发函质询、推动立法的方式施压。文中提到的“预测市场”（prediction market）是近年另一类受关注的新型平台，常被批评与体育博彩界线模糊。

background.title: “负责任博彩”与问题赌博
background.text_zh: “负责任博彩”（responsible gaming）是博彩业的自律概念，通常包括存款限额、下注限额、时长提醒、冷静期（cool-off）、自我排除名单等工具，由用户自行设置。批评者认为，这类工具默认关闭、提示微弱、设置后又容易被营销推送抵消，实际效果有限。美国问题赌博全国委员会（National Council on Problem Gambling, NCPG）是推动相关研究与求助热线的非营利机构。文中路易斯安那州卫生官员所称“赌博障碍”（gambling disorder），是美国精神医学学会诊断手册中的正式诊断名称，取代了旧称“病理性赌博”。

title_en: ‘What we leave behind is not as important as how we’ve lived’: remembering actor Patrick Stewart
excerpt_en: Passing away this week at 86, Stewart will be remembered as actor, dramaturge, Shakespearean exemplar, mutant professor, and distinguished Starfleet captain.
body_en: At the end of Star Trek: Generations (1994), surveying the wreckage of the crashed USS Enterprise he captained for nearly a decade, Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) muses to his first officer, William Riker (Jonathan Frakes):
… time is a companion that goes with us on the journey, reminds us to cherish every moment, because it will never come again. What we leave behind is not as important as how we’ve lived.
Smiling, he quips to Riker, “After all, Number One, we’re only mortal.”

Passing away this week at 86 years old, we are sadly reminded of that mortality with the death of Sir Patrick Stewart: actor, dramaturge, Shakespearean exemplar, mutant professor, and distinguished Starfleet captain.
From humble beginnings Born in Mirfield, England, in 1940, Stewart grew up poor during the worst days of the second world war.
He found his calling to theatre as a child, thanks to a keen-eyed English teacher and a copy of Shakespeare’s plays.
He left school at 15 to become a working actor in community theatre.
His extraordinary talent would lead to a stay at the Bristol Old Vic Theatre School, membership with the Royal Shakespeare Company, and a host of acclaimed theatre performances.
Despite the many screen roles for which Stewart would later be known, his Shakespearean roots are indelibly intertwined with almost every performance he gave.

They would also give him – and many of us – something to lighten the load of COVID lockdowns. Stewart used social media in 2020 to read the internet a Shakespearean sonnet each day, later turning his delightful orations into an audiobook.
For most, Stewart will best be remembered as a kaleidoscopic titan of film and television.
Beginning as a firefighter on the British soap opera Coronation Street in 1967, Stewart’s illustrious screen career spanned more than 50 years and a vast array of roles.

a flamboyant interior designer a stoic Atreides weapon master in a screen adaptation of the Dune books the irreverent king of England a foul-mouthed CIA deputy director an enigmatic cult leader, and a megalomaniacal egg-alien overlord. Two key roles From his storied body of work, two roles loom largest.

He was the telepathic mutant and academic Charles Xavier of the X-Men film series – a role he played for more than 25 years, including a posthumous appearance in Avengers: Doomsday (released this December).

As Professor X, Stewart embodied a beloved superhero with paternal warmth and secretive, calculating intellect. He was an empathetic leader of a team of extraordinary people who had been shunned, threatened and harmed by the world for their differences.

One cannot help but think this role enabled Stewart to channel much of his real-life allyship with marginalised queer communities and his support for survivors of domestic violence (which was based on his own childhood experiences).

In this role, Stewart acted alongside his long-time friend Sir Ian McKellen, who played the mutant antagonist and master of metal Magneto. Ironically, McKellen had once warned Stewart not to forsake the theatre for the screen, advising that a career in film and television would go nowhere.

Stewart and McKellen’s endearing friendship and acclaimed X-Men performances became the stuff of internet legend, particularly when McKellen officiated Stewart’s wedding to US singer Sunny Ozell in 2013.
Stewart’s work in Star Trek as Jean-Luc Picard – captain (later admiral) of the USS Enterprise – is equally revered.

As Stewart’s first major American television role, he took the captain’s chair in Star Trek: The Next Generation in 1987. He would eventually appear in seven seasons, four theatrical films, and the recent sequel series Star Trek: Picard.

Despite initial reservations – including an infamous on-set incident where he stoically told his rambunctious Next Generation colleagues that “ we are not here to have fun ” – Stewart later embraced the role of Picard. He will be remembered as one of Star Trek’s most acclaimed and legendary performers.
As Picard, Stewart created a potent role model in a franchise focused on an inclusive, utopian future.

enrich.title_zh: “我们留下什么，不如我们如何活过”：追忆演员帕特里克·斯图尔特
enrich.summary_zh: 本文是《对话》为英国演员帕特里克·斯图尔特撰写的纪念文章。文章回顾了这位战后贫寒少年如何凭莎剧功底进入皇家莎士比亚剧团，又凭《星际迷航》中的皮卡德舰长和《X战警》中的X教授成为影视传奇；并指出，他塑造的那些包容、庇护弱者的角色，与他现实生活中对边缘群体的声援一脉相承。

paragraphs.en: At the end of Star Trek: Generations (1994), surveying the wreckage of the crashed USS Enterprise he captained for nearly a decade, Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) muses to his first officer, William Riker (Jonathan Frakes):
paragraphs.zh: 在《星际迷航：日换星移》（1994）的结尾，让-吕克·皮卡德（帕特里克·斯图尔特饰）望着自己担任舰长近十年的“企业号”星舰坠毁后的残骸，若有所思地对大副威廉·赖克（乔纳森·弗雷克斯饰）说道：

paragraphs.en: … time is a companion that goes with us on the journey, reminds us to cherish every moment, because it will never come again. What we leave behind is not as important as how we’ve lived.
paragraphs.zh: ……时间是一位旅伴，陪我们走过这段旅程，提醒我们珍惜每一刻，因为它一去不返。我们身后留下什么，并不如我们如何活过重要。

paragraphs.en: Smiling, he quips to Riker, “After all, Number One, we’re only mortal.”
paragraphs.zh: 他微微一笑，冲赖克打趣道：“毕竟，一号，我们终究是凡人。”

paragraphs.en: Passing away this week at 86 years old, we are sadly reminded of that mortality with the death of Sir Patrick Stewart: actor, dramaturge, Shakespearean exemplar, mutant professor, and distinguished Starfleet captain.
paragraphs.zh: 本周，帕特里克·斯图尔特爵士以86岁高龄离世，令人悲伤地再次想起人之必死：他是演员、戏剧家、莎剧典范、变种人教授，也是功勋卓著的星际舰队舰长。

paragraphs.en: From humble beginnings Born in Mirfield, England, in 1940, Stewart grew up poor during the worst days of the second world war.
paragraphs.zh: 出身寒微：斯图尔特1940年生于英格兰米尔菲尔德，在第二次世界大战最艰苦的岁月里于贫困中长大。

paragraphs.en: He found his calling to theatre as a child, thanks to a keen-eyed English teacher and a copy of Shakespeare’s plays.
paragraphs.zh: 他童年时就找到了自己对话剧的志业，这要归功于一位眼光敏锐的英语老师和一本莎士比亚剧作集。

paragraphs.en: He left school at 15 to become a working actor in community theatre.
paragraphs.zh: 他15岁便离开学校，成为社区剧院里的一名职业演员。

paragraphs.en: His extraordinary talent would lead to a stay at the Bristol Old Vic Theatre School, membership with the Royal Shakespeare Company, and a host of acclaimed theatre performances.
paragraphs.zh: 他非凡的天赋让他得以进入布里斯托老维克戏剧学校，加入皇家莎士比亚剧团，并奉献了一系列广受赞誉的舞台演出。

paragraphs.en: Despite the many screen roles for which Stewart would later be known, his Shakespearean roots are indelibly intertwined with almost every performance he gave.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管斯图尔特日后为人们熟知的是众多银幕角色，但他的莎剧根基与他几乎每一次表演都不可磨灭地交织在一起。

paragraphs.en: They would also give him – and many of us – something to lighten the load of COVID lockdowns. Stewart used social media in 2020 to read the internet a Shakespearean sonnet each day, later turning his delightful orations into an audiobook.
paragraphs.zh: 这份根基也给了他——以及我们许多人——在新冠封控期间减轻重负的东西。2020年，斯图尔特借助社交媒体，每天为网上的读者朗读一首莎士比亚十四行诗，后来又把那些令人愉悦的朗诵做成了有声书。

paragraphs.en: For most, Stewart will best be remembered as a kaleidoscopic titan of film and television.
paragraphs.zh: 对大多数人而言，斯图尔特最令人铭记的身份是影视界一位千姿百态的巨匠。

paragraphs.en: Beginning as a firefighter on the British soap opera Coronation Street in 1967, Stewart’s illustrious screen career spanned more than 50 years and a vast array of roles.
paragraphs.zh: 斯图尔特1967年以英国肥皂剧《加冕街》中的消防员一角起步，他辉煌的银幕生涯跨越五十余年，角色类型极其丰富。

paragraphs.en: a flamboyant interior designer a stoic Atreides weapon master in a screen adaptation of the Dune books the irreverent king of England a foul-mouthed CIA deputy director an enigmatic cult leader, and a megalomaniacal egg-alien overlord. Two key roles From his storied body of work, two roles loom largest.
paragraphs.zh: 一个张扬浮夸的室内设计师；《沙丘》系列影视改编中亚崔迪家族沉默坚忍的武器大师；一位不敬神明的英格兰国王；一位满口脏话的中情局副局长；一位神秘莫测的邪教领袖；以及一位自大狂妄的蛋形外星霸主。两个关键角色：在他传奇般的作品谱系中，有两个角色最为突出。

paragraphs.en: He was the telepathic mutant and academic Charles Xavier of the X-Men film series – a role he played for more than 25 years, including a posthumous appearance in Avengers: Doomsday (released this December).
paragraphs.zh: 他是《X战警》系列电影中那位具有心灵感应能力的变种人学者查尔斯·泽维尔——这个角色他演了超过二十五年，其中还包括今年12月上映的《复仇者联盟：末日》中的一次身后亮相。

paragraphs.en: As Professor X, Stewart embodied a beloved superhero with paternal warmth and secretive, calculating intellect. He was an empathetic leader of a team of extraordinary people who had been shunned, threatened and harmed by the world for their differences.
paragraphs.zh: 作为X教授，斯图尔特以父亲般的温情与深藏不露、精于算计的智慧，塑造了一位深受喜爱的超级英雄。他是一群非凡之人的共情领袖——这些人因其与众不同而被世界排斥、威胁和伤害。

paragraphs.en: One cannot help but think this role enabled Stewart to channel much of his real-life allyship with marginalised queer communities and his support for survivors of domestic violence (which was based on his own childhood experiences).
paragraphs.zh: 人们不禁会觉得，正是这个角色让斯图尔特得以倾注他在现实生活中对边缘化酷儿群体的支持，以及对家庭暴力幸存者的声援（后者源于他本人的童年经历）。

paragraphs.en: In this role, Stewart acted alongside his long-time friend Sir Ian McKellen, who played the mutant antagonist and master of metal Magneto. Ironically, McKellen had once warned Stewart not to forsake the theatre for the screen, advising that a career in film and television would go nowhere.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个角色中，斯图尔特与多年好友伊恩·麦克莱恩爵士同台，后者饰演变种人反派、金属之主万磁王。颇具讽刺意味的是，麦克莱恩曾劝斯图尔特不要为银幕而舍弃戏剧，还说影视圈的事业不会有什么前途。

paragraphs.en: Stewart and McKellen’s endearing friendship and acclaimed X-Men performances became the stuff of internet legend, particularly when McKellen officiated Stewart’s wedding to US singer Sunny Ozell in 2013.
paragraphs.zh: 斯图尔特与麦克莱恩之间惹人喜爱的友谊和广受赞誉的《X战警》表演，成了网络上的传奇谈资，尤其是2013年麦克莱恩为斯图尔特与美国歌手桑妮·奥泽尔的婚礼主持仪式一事。

paragraphs.en: Stewart’s work in Star Trek as Jean-Luc Picard – captain (later admiral) of the USS Enterprise – is equally revered.
paragraphs.zh: 斯图尔特在《星际迷航》中饰演企业号舰长（后为上将）让-吕克·皮卡德的表现，同样备受尊崇。

paragraphs.en: As Stewart’s first major American television role, he took the captain’s chair in Star Trek: The Next Generation in 1987. He would eventually appear in seven seasons, four theatrical films, and the recent sequel series Star Trek: Picard.
paragraphs.zh: 这是斯图尔特第一个重要的美国电视角色，1987年他在《星际迷航：下一代》中坐上了舰长座椅。他最终出演了七季剧集、四部院线电影，以及近年的续篇剧集《星际迷航：皮卡德》。

paragraphs.en: Despite initial reservations – including an infamous on-set incident where he stoically told his rambunctious Next Generation colleagues that “ we are not here to have fun ” – Stewart later embraced the role of Picard. He will be remembered as one of Star Trek’s most acclaimed and legendary performers.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管他起初心存疑虑——包括一次有名的片场风波：他一脸严肃地告诫那些闹哄哄的《下一代》同僚“我们不是来这儿玩的”——斯图尔特后来还是接纳了皮卡德这个角色。他将作为《星际迷航》中最受赞誉、最具传奇色彩的演员之一而被铭记。

paragraphs.en: As Picard, Stewart created a potent role model in a franchise focused on an inclusive, utopian future.
paragraphs.zh: 通过皮卡德，斯图尔特在这部着眼于包容性乌托邦未来的系列作品中，树立了一个极具感召力的榜样。

vocab.meaning_zh: （若有所思地）自语、沉吟；沉思地说
vocab.example_en: She mused aloud about how quickly the years had gone by.
vocab.example_zh: 她自言自语地感慨岁月流逝得多么快。

vocab.meaning_zh: 打趣说，俏皮地说（带点机智或自嘲）
vocab.example_en: “At least the traffic was light,” he quipped as the rain poured down.
vocab.example_zh: 大雨倾盆时他打趣道：“至少路上不堵。”

vocab.meaning_zh: 必死的命运；人之终有一死
vocab.example_en: The pandemic forced many people to confront their own mortality.
vocab.example_zh: 疫情迫使许多人直面自己的必死之身。

vocab.meaning_zh: 戏剧家；（剧团的）戏剧顾问、剧本编审
vocab.example_en: He worked for years as a dramaturge at a regional theatre.
vocab.example_zh: 他在一家地区剧院做了多年戏剧顾问。

vocab.meaning_zh: 不可磨灭地，无法抹去地
vocab.example_en: That summer was indelibly printed on her memory.
vocab.example_zh: 那个夏天不可磨灭地印在了她的记忆里。

vocab.meaning_zh: 千变万化的，五花八门、色彩斑斓的
vocab.example_en: The film is a kaleidoscopic portrait of a city in flux.
vocab.example_zh: 这部影片是一幅变化之城的万花筒式画像。

vocab.meaning_zh: 辉煌的，声名卓著的（多形容事业、履历、家族）
vocab.example_en: She had an illustrious career in broadcast journalism.
vocab.example_zh: 她在广播电视新闻界拥有辉煌的职业生涯。

vocab.meaning_zh: 坚忍的，不动声色的，能忍痛而不形于色的

vocab.example_zh: 判决宣读时，他始终保持镇定。

vocab.example_en: After the scandal he was shunned by former colleagues.

sentences.en: At the end of Star Trek: Generations (1994), surveying the wreckage of the crashed USS Enterprise he captained for nearly a decade, Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) muses to his first officer, William Riker (Jonathan Frakes):
sentences.structure: 主干：Jean-Luc Picard muses to his first officer（主谓宾补）；修饰：At the end of… 时间状语前置；surveying the wreckage… 现在分词短语作伴随状语，说明主句动作发生的场景；he captained for nearly a decade 是省略 that/which 的定语从句，修饰 the crashed USS Enterprise
sentences.analysis_zh: 英语常用“状语在前、主干在后”的尾重结构：先由时间状语和分词状语铺出画面，主语 Jean-Luc Picard 一直到句中偏后位置才出现，读者在末尾才拿到主要信息，从而产生“镜头缓缓推近人物”的效果。注意 survey 这里不是“调查”而是“审视、打量”，surveying the wreckage 是“望着残骸”。he captained 前的企业号之前还有近十年的定语，信息层层叠加，翻译时宜拆成短句。

sentences.en: One cannot help but think this role enabled Stewart to channel much of his real-life allyship with marginalised queer communities and his support for survivors of domestic violence (which was based on his own childhood experiences).
sentences.structure: 主干：One cannot help but think + 宾语从句；宾语从句主干 this role enabled Stewart to channel A and B（enable sb to do）；A = much of his real-life allyship with marginalised queer communities，B = his support for survivors of domestic violence；which 引导定语从句修饰 support（也可理解为修饰其背后的经历）
sentences.analysis_zh: cannot help but do 是固定搭配，“不禁、忍不住”，比 cannot help doing 更书面。channel 在此是“倾注、疏导（情感）”之意，外刊常用。两个并列宾语都很长，中间用 and 连接，容易读丢：看到 allyship 之后要知道 and 后面还有一个 his support，两者共用 channel。括号里的 which 从句补充说明这种声援的私人来源，翻译时可保留括号或转为破折号。

sentences.en: Despite initial reservations – including an infamous on-set incident where he stoically told his rambunctious Next Generation colleagues that “we are not here to have fun” – Stewart later embraced the role of Picard.
sentences.structure: 主干：Stewart embraced the role of Picard（主谓宾）；修饰：Despite initial reservations 让步状语；including… 修饰 reservations，举出具体例证；where… 定语从句修饰 incident；that… 宾语从句作 told 的直接宾语
sentences.analysis_zh: 破折号插入的长成分把主语和谓语隔开了 20 多个词，这是外刊常见的“主干让路”写法：主句其实极短（Stewart later embraced the role），全部重量都压在插入语上。阅读时应先跳过破折号内容抓主干，再回头补细节。later 与 Despite 呼应，构成“先排斥、后接纳”的转折弧线。

background.title: 企业号、皮卡德与那个“Number One”
background.text_zh: 《星际迷航》由吉恩·罗登伯里于1966年推出，以星际舰队为背景，宣扬探索、多元与理性，被视作美国科幻电视的里程碑。文章提到的皮卡德舰长出自1987—1994年的续作《星际迷航：下一代》（The Next Generation，简称TNG），这一角色让斯图尔特真正走入美国主流视野。星舰上的“Number One”是舰长对大副（First Officer，即副舰长）的传统称呼，源自航海惯例，意为“一号人物”，剧迷因此常以此代指赖克。

background.title: 皇家莎士比亚剧团与英国演员的“莎剧血统”
background.text_zh: 皇家莎士比亚剧团（Royal Shakespeare Company, RSC）以莎士比亚故乡斯特拉特福为基地，是英国最具权威的剧团之一；布里斯托老维克戏剧学校（Bristol Old Vic Theatre School）同样是英国老牌表演学府。在英国演艺界，出身莎剧舞台的演员往往被视为“功底派”，转战影视后仍带有舞台烙印——这正是文章反复强调斯图尔特“莎剧根基”的原因。此外，《X战警》中长期被解读为X教授与万磁王分别对应马丁·路德·金与马尔科姆·X的两种抗争路线，这也解释了文中为何将X教授与“包容性”“边缘群体”联系在一起。

title_en: Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents
excerpt_en: The post Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents appeared first on ProPublica.
body_en: ProPublica Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets will inevitably result not only in the erosion of rights for immigrants but also for citizens. Since the start of this Trump administration, we’ve watched those warnings come true.

So we have once again done what the government won’t: We have tallied and cataloged every case we can find of an immigration agent reportedly detaining a citizen during the current administration — more than 500 cases from Inauguration Day through Oct. 21, 2026.
Read our earlier reporting on U.S. citizens being detained.

We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media, and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it. We asked the Department of Homeland Security about each incident, and we searched for any federal criminal charges that were brought in relation to each incident. (DHS has repeatedly said it is not arresting U.S. citizens.)

Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost certainly an undercount. Below, we’re showing you every case we found — the reality that the administration denies — along with the receipts. Read more about how we reported this project.
The post Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents appeared first on ProPublica.

enrich.title_zh: 检索 500 多起美国公民被移民执法人员拘留的案例
enrich.summary_zh: ProPublica 汇总了本届特朗普政府任期内（就职日至 2026 年 10 月 21 日）据报道被移民执法人员拘留的美国公民案例，共 500 多起。这些案例来自社交媒体、法庭记录和当地媒体，每起至少有两个信息来源；记者还向国土安全部逐案求证。由于政府本身不统计这类事件，清单很可能仍有遗漏，但已足以呈现官方否认的现实。

paragraphs.en: ProPublica Experts have long warned that immigration dragnets will inevitably result not only in the erosion of rights for immigrants but also for citizens. Since the start of this Trump administration, we’ve watched those warnings come true.
paragraphs.zh: ProPublica 长期以来，专家们一直警告说，移民领域的拉网式搜捕不可避免地不仅会侵蚀移民的权利，也会侵蚀公民的权利。自本届特朗普政府上任以来，我们亲眼看着这些警告一一应验。

paragraphs.en: So we have once again done what the government won’t: We have tallied and cataloged every case we can find of an immigration agent reportedly detaining a citizen during the current administration — more than 500 cases from Inauguration Day through Oct. 21, 2026.
paragraphs.zh: 于是，我们再一次做了政府不会去做的事：我们统计并逐条记录了本届政府任期内所有能找到的、据报道由移民执法人员拘留美国公民的案例——从总统就职日到 2026 年 10 月 21 日，共 500 多起。

paragraphs.en: Read our earlier reporting on U.S. citizens being detained.
paragraphs.zh: 阅读我们此前关于美国公民被拘留的报道。

paragraphs.en: We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media, and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it. We asked the Department of Homeland Security about each incident, and we searched for any federal criminal charges that were brought in relation to each incident. (DHS has repeatedly said it is not arresting U.S. citizens.)
paragraphs.zh: 我们的清单是通过检索社交媒体、法庭记录和当地媒体汇编而成的；只有当我们能为一起事件找到至少两个信息来源时，才会把它收入清单。我们就每一起事件向国土安全部求证，并查找与每起事件相关的任何联邦刑事指控。（国土安全部已多次表示，该部门并未逮捕美国公民。）

paragraphs.en: Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost certainly an undercount. Below, we’re showing you every case we found — the reality that the administration denies — along with the receipts. Read more about how we reported this project.
paragraphs.zh: 由于政府本身并不追踪这类案例，我们的清单几乎可以肯定存在漏计。下面我们列出找到的每一起案例，连同证据一并呈现，这就是本届政府所否认的现实。了解更多关于我们如何开展这一项目报道的信息。

paragraphs.en: The post Search More Than 500 Cases of U.S. Citizens Detained by Immigration Agents appeared first on ProPublica.
paragraphs.zh: 《检索 500 多起美国公民被移民执法人员拘留的案例》一文最先发布于 ProPublica。

vocab.meaning_zh: 拉网式搜捕，撒网式抓捕（原意为拖网）
vocab.example_en: The mayor defended the police dragnet that swept up dozens of bystanders.
vocab.example_zh: 市长为那次把数十名旁观者一并卷入的大范围搜捕进行了辩护。

vocab.meaning_zh: （权利、价值等的）逐步侵蚀、削弱
vocab.example_en: Critics see the new rule as a further erosion of press freedom.
vocab.example_zh: 批评者认为这项新规进一步侵蚀了新闻自由。

vocab.meaning_zh: 统计，清点（数量）
vocab.example_en: Volunteers tallied the number of complaints filed last year.
vocab.example_zh: 志愿者统计了去年收到的投诉数量。

vocab.meaning_zh: 逐条记录，编目整理
vocab.example_en: The report catalogs every documented case of wrongful arrest.
vocab.example_zh: 这份报告逐条记录了每一桩有据可查的错误逮捕案例。

vocab.meaning_zh: （美国总统）就职日，通常指 1 月 20 日
vocab.example_en: The order took effect hours after Inauguration Day.
vocab.example_zh: 该命令在总统就职日数小时后就生效了。

vocab.meaning_zh: 仔细搜索，遍查（资料、地点等）
vocab.example_en: Reporters scoured court filings for any mention of the firm.
vocab.example_zh: 记者们翻遍了法庭文件，寻找任何提及该公司的内容。

vocab.meaning_zh: 漏计，统计不足的数量
vocab.example_en: Officials conceded the figure was likely an undercount.
vocab.example_zh: 官员承认这一数字很可能存在漏计。

vocab.meaning_zh: （口语/新闻用语）证据，凭据，实锤
vocab.example_en: She showed up with the receipts: emails, invoices and photos.
vocab.example_zh: 她带着实锤来了：邮件、发票和照片。

vocab.meaning_zh: （对某人）提出指控，提起诉讼
vocab.example_en: No charges were brought against the officers involved.
vocab.example_zh: 涉案警员未受到任何指控。

vocab.meaning_zh: 拘留，扣押（未经正式逮捕的短期羁押）
vocab.example_en: The traveler was detained at the airport for six hours.
vocab.example_zh: 这名旅客在机场被扣留了六个小时。

sentences.en: We have tallied and cataloged every case we can find of an immigration agent reportedly detaining a citizen during the current administration — more than 500 cases from Inauguration Day through Oct. 21, 2026.
sentences.structure: 主干：We have tallied and cataloged every case（主谓宾，现在完成时）。修饰：we can find 是省略关系代词 that 的定语从句，修饰 case；of an immigration agent reportedly detaining a citizen 是介词短语，同样后置修饰 case，因被定语从句隔开而显得远离中心词；during the current administration 是时间状语；破折号后 more than 500 cases... 是对前面 every case 的同位补充。
sentences.analysis_zh: 这句的难点是修饰语“排队”：case 后面先接定语从句 we can find，再接 of + 动名词复合结构（an immigration agent detaining a citizen），读者要在心里把两层修饰都挂回 case。reportedly 一词很关键，它是记者在法律风险下的免责标记：这是“据报道”，而不是本报亲自证实的事实。破折号后的数字则把抽象的“每一起”落实为可核查的量级，是调查报道常用的“先给方法、再给规模”的写法。

sentences.en: We compiled our list by scouring social media, court records and local media, and we included an incident only if we could find at least two sources for it.
sentences.structure: 由 and 连接的两个并列分句。前一分句主干：We compiled our list；by scouring... 是方式状语，说明“怎么编的”。后一分句主干：we included an incident；only if 引导条件状语从句，only 限定条件，意为“只有在……的情况下才”。
sentences.analysis_zh: by doing 结构把“方法”放在句末，符合英语“先结论后手段”的信息顺序，译成中文时宜提前为“我们通过……汇编清单”。only if 是外刊高频的限定表达，语气比 if 强得多，等于“非……不可”，用在这里是为了向读者保证收录门槛：单一来源的传闻一律不进清单。这一句实际上是整篇报道的方法论声明，也是其可信度的来源。

sentences.en: Since the government itself does not track these cases, our list is almost certainly an undercount.
sentences.structure: 主干：our list is an undercount（主系表）。Since 引导原因状语从句，置于句首；itself 是反身代词，用于强调“政府自己”；almost certainly 是程度副词修饰整个判断。
sentences.analysis_zh: Since 在这里不是“自从”，而是“既然、由于”，引导原因，这是六级到考研阶段最容易误判的用法之一。句子用“政府不统计”作为原因，推出“我们的清单必然不全”，逻辑上是先自曝短板再立论：正因为官方没有数据，民间统计才有存在价值。almost certainly 保留了记者的谨慎，避免把结论说得过满，这是调查报道的典型分寸感。

background.title: 美国移民执法机构与公民被误拘问题
background.text_zh: 美国境内的移民执法主要由国土安全部（DHS）下属的移民与海关执法局（ICE）承担；海关与边境保护局（CBP）则负责边境与口岸。ICE 的执法权限来自联邦移民法，理论上针对的是非公民，但在实际操作中，因身份核查、种族外貌误判、执法范围扩大等原因，美国公民被拦查、拘留甚至递解的情况在历史上多次见诸报道，这也是民权组织长期关注的议题。DHS 的公开立场是“不逮捕美国公民”，因此官方并不存在“公民被移民执法拘留”的专项统计，这正是 ProPublica 强调“政府自己不做这件事”的背景。

background.title: ProPublica 是谁
background.text_zh: ProPublica 是一家美国非营利性调查新闻机构，2007 年成立，总部在纽约，以长篇调查报道和数据新闻著称，多次获得普利策奖。它的报道通常免费转载给合作媒体，并习惯单列“我们如何报道这个项目”（How we reported this）的方法说明，公开信息来源数量、求证流程与数据库结构。本文中“每起事件至少两个来源”“逐案向 DHS 求证”等表述，正是这种透明化方法论的体现。文末“The post ... appeared first on ProPublica”是该站 RSS 输出的固定版权尾巴，不是正文内容。

title_en: How porn became so extreme – and how it’s shaping the sex lives of young people
excerpt_en: Extreme pornography has become readily available on mainstream porn sites. Clare McGlynn explains what this is doing to the sex lives of young people.
body_en: A few years ago, the singer Billie Eilish opened up on the Howard Stern Show about how she began watching porn around age 11.
“I’m so angry that porn is so loved, and I’m so angry at myself for thinking that it was ok,” she said.

Eilish became addicted to porn, and it led to problems. “The first few times I had sex, I was not saying no to things that were not good,” she said. She had nightmares because the content she was watching was so violent and abusive.

Online porn is a multi-million dollar business, driven by algorithms designed to keep people clicking for more. These algorithms push more and more extreme content, often for free, to people who didn’t go searching for it. This can include strangulation, exploitation or incest porn, that’s often misogynistic and racist too.

“If you take incest and strangulation, we can look at content studies from the 1980s, for example, when there was hardly any of that material,” Clare McGlynn, professor of law at Durham University in the UK, tells The Conversation Weekly podcast. “Today both incest and strangulation becomes mainstream.”

In the UK, the government will ban the possession and publication of incest and strangulation porn from early November. McGlynn, who worked with civil society groups to push the regulation of extreme content, says it’s a “huge step” that sends a message about the harms of “normalising sexual violence”.
McGlynn, who has written a recent book about the rise of extreme porn, says large online porn platforms are pushing people towards more and more extreme content.

Their business model is to keep you engaged. They want us on the platform for as long as possible, and the way to do that is to feed you more content, not necessarily what you were looking for, but also, the more extreme, the more polarising, the more shocking content … unfortunately, that seems to be what our kind of base instincts go for and what does actually engage us to keep us searching.
McGlynn says an abundance of extreme and violent porn is shaping the sex lives of young people, and it can lead to an increased risk of problematic behaviour.

There’s a study that followed 16,000 young people, showing that high porn use, particularly at a young age, is a big risk factor in problematic sexual behaviour of young teenage boys. And there’s studies in Australia and the US … showing that the more porn they watch, the more strangulation they see, and then the more they identify that they act out the strangulation.

enrich.title_zh: 色情内容为何变得如此极端——以及它如何塑造年轻人的性生活
enrich.summary_zh: 歌手 Billie Eilish 自曝11岁起看色情片上瘾，并因此在性关系中不敢拒绝。杜伦大学法学教授 Clare McGlynn 指出，色情平台靠算法不断推送更极端的内容，勒颈、乱伦等题材逐渐主流化；英国将从11月初起禁止此类内容的持有与发布。研究还显示，大量观看极端色情与青少年男孩的问题性行为、模仿勒颈存在关联。

paragraphs.en: A few years ago, the singer Billie Eilish opened up on the Howard Stern Show about how she began watching porn around age 11.
paragraphs.zh: 几年前，歌手比莉·艾利什（Billie Eilish）在《霍华德·斯特恩秀》节目中坦率地谈起，自己大约11岁时开始看色情片。

paragraphs.en: “I’m so angry that porn is so loved, and I’m so angry at myself for thinking that it was ok,” she said.
paragraphs.zh: “色情内容竟然如此受欢迎，这让我非常愤怒；我也很生自己的气，因为我曾觉得这没什么问题。”她说。

paragraphs.en: Eilish became addicted to porn, and it led to problems. “The first few times I had sex, I was not saying no to things that were not good,” she said. She had nightmares because the content she was watching was so violent and abusive.
paragraphs.zh: 艾利什对色情内容上了瘾，并因此出了问题。“最初几次发生性关系时，对那些并不好的事情，我都没有说不。”她说。她做噩梦，因为她看的内容如此暴力、如此带有虐待性。

paragraphs.en: Online porn is a multi-million dollar business, driven by algorithms designed to keep people clicking for more. These algorithms push more and more extreme content, often for free, to people who didn’t go searching for it. This can include strangulation, exploitation or incest porn, that’s often misogynistic and racist too.
paragraphs.zh: 网络色情是一门价值数百万美元的生意，其驱动力是那些旨在让人不断点击、欲罢不能的算法。这些算法把越来越极端的内容推送给并没有主动搜索它们的人，而且往往还是免费的。这些内容包括勒颈、剥削或乱伦题材的色情片，它们往往还带有厌女和种族主义色彩。

paragraphs.en: “If you take incest and strangulation, we can look at content studies from the 1980s, for example, when there was hardly any of that material,” Clare McGlynn, professor of law at Durham University in the UK, tells The Conversation Weekly podcast. “Today both incest and strangulation becomes mainstream.”
paragraphs.zh: “以乱伦和勒颈为例，我们可以看看20世纪80年代的内容研究，那时这类素材几乎不存在，”英国杜伦大学法学教授克莱尔·麦格琳（Clare McGlynn）在《对话周刊》播客中说，“如今乱伦和勒颈都成了主流。”

paragraphs.en: In the UK, the government will ban the possession and publication of incest and strangulation porn from early November. McGlynn, who worked with civil society groups to push the regulation of extreme content, says it’s a “huge step” that sends a message about the harms of “normalising sexual violence”.
paragraphs.zh: 在英国，政府将从11月初起禁止持有和发布乱伦与勒颈类色情内容。麦格琳曾与公民社会组织合作推动对极端内容的监管，她称这是“巨大的一步”，并认为它传递出一个信号：把性暴力“正常化”会造成伤害。

paragraphs.en: McGlynn, who has written a recent book about the rise of extreme porn, says large online porn platforms are pushing people towards more and more extreme content.
paragraphs.zh: 麦格琳最近写了一本关于极端色情内容兴起的书，她说，大型网络色情平台正把人们推向越来越极端的内容。

paragraphs.en: Their business model is to keep you engaged. They want us on the platform for as long as possible, and the way to do that is to feed you more content, not necessarily what you were looking for, but also, the more extreme, the more polarising, the more shocking content … unfortunately, that seems to be what our kind of base instincts go for and what does actually engage us to keep us searching.
paragraphs.zh: 它们的商业模式就是让你一直看下去。它们希望我们在平台上待得越久越好，而做到这一点的方法，就是不断喂给你更多内容：未必是你原本在找的东西，还包括那些越极端、越能撕裂舆论、越令人震惊的内容……不幸的是，这似乎正是我们这类本能所追逐的东西，也正是真正能抓住我们、让我们不停搜下去的东西。

paragraphs.en: McGlynn says an abundance of extreme and violent porn is shaping the sex lives of young people, and it can lead to an increased risk of problematic behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 麦格琳说，大量极端、暴力的色情内容正在塑造年轻人的性生活，并可能提高出现有问题行为的风险。

paragraphs.en: There’s a study that followed 16,000 young people, showing that high porn use, particularly at a young age, is a big risk factor in problematic sexual behaviour of young teenage boys. And there’s studies in Australia and the US … showing that the more porn they watch, the more strangulation they see, and then the more they identify that they act out the strangulation.
paragraphs.zh: 有一项研究跟踪了1.6万名年轻人，结果显示，大量观看色情内容，尤其是在年纪很小时就大量观看，是十几岁男孩出现有问题性行为的一个重要风险因素。澳大利亚和美国的研究也显示，他们看的色情内容越多，看到的勒颈画面就越多，随后就越会承认自己真的去模仿、实施了勒颈行为。
